# mandatum

> **Beta, pre-1.0, not recommended for production.** Interfaces are stabilizing but may change between minor versions. The single-binary deployment (in-memory bus, ledger and registry) is complete and tested; the Redis Streams bus backend is conformance-tested but its integration tests skip without a Redis; there is no persistent registry yet, so agent specs do not survive a restart.

> Agent platform and low-latency pub/sub bus for agents. Define an agent with a declarative spec, tag it from Slack, GitHub, Jira or a schedule, and stream its events to any subscriber while delivering them to any destination. The design turns on one idea: where a tag is raised and where its answer lands are independent, which is what makes it a mesh rather than a set of integrations. Composes three libraries: saige (agent loop, typed deltas, RAG citations), duraturo (durable execution, ledger as truth, replay), and legatus (sandboxed execution nodes, NGAC access control). Go module `github.com/urmzd/mandatum`, binary `mandatum` with `serve`, `work`, `agent`, `tag`, `listen`, `version`, `update`.

## Key Concepts

- Topic: one namespace, matched by segment-wise prefix. `agent` (every agent), `agent:<name>` (every run of one agent, what users listen to), `agent:<name>:<runID>` (one run, where events are published). No wildcard language. `agent:docs` does NOT cover `agent:docs-bot`.
- Not topics, deliberately: event kind and agent revision are FIELDS filtered on one subscription (`envelope.Filter`); tenant is an authorization scope taken from the caller's credential and never named by a subscriber; destination is a `Route` on the run.
- Connector faces, independent and derived by `connector.RolesOf` rather than declared: `Trigger` raises tags, `Sink` renders events onto a native surface, `Actor` contributes native verbs as agent tools. slack/github/jira do all three; cron triggers only (a schedule has no surface); webhook sinks only (an outbound POST raises nothing).
- N:M delivery: one tag fans out to many sinks, one sink serves many agents, and each `Route` selects its own kinds via `Route.Wants`. A GitHub comment takes every delta and is edited in place while a webhook on the same run takes only `lifecycle.completed`.
- Revision pinning: an `AgentSpec` is immutable; revising appends N+1. A run pins its revision (and its content hash) at accept time and executes against it forever, because duraturo replays workflows from the top and an unpinned run would diverge with `ErrNonDeterministic`. Delete is a tombstone: `Get(name, rev)` still resolves so a completed run stays explicable.
- Dual publish: `duraturo.Emit` writes the durable per-run journal (replay, cursor resume); `bus.Publish` writes the live cross-run bus (observers, delivery). The journal is truth, the bus is flow.
- Idempotency: `Tag.ID` is the run id, so a Slack retry or GitHub redelivery joins the existing run instead of answering twice.
- Security boundaries: `pkg/signature` (HMAC over the raw body, verified before parsing, `hmac.Equal`, Slack replay window, fail closed) and the NGAC policy path (default deny, workspace areas and spawn allowlist).

## Key Files

- Leaves (stdlib only): pkg/topic/topic.go, pkg/address/address.go, pkg/envelope/envelope.go, pkg/signature/signature.go, pkg/agentspec/{agentspec,hash}.go
- Seams: pkg/connector/connector.go, pkg/bus/{bus,memory,redis}.go, pkg/bus/bustest/suite.go, pkg/registry/{registry,memory,adapt,token}.go
- Composition: pkg/agentrt/{agentrt,translate,citation,provider,spec,tools}.go, pkg/agentrt/payload/payload.go, pkg/runtime/{runtime,sandbox,seq}.go, pkg/router/{router,delivery}.go
- Connectors: pkg/connectors/{slack,github,jira,cron,webhook}/, shared helpers in pkg/connectors/internal/{httpjson,inbound,render,sink}/ and pkg/connectors/mention/
- Transport: proto/mandatum/v1/{agent,bus,invoke}.proto, gen/mandatum/v1/ (committed), internal/server/{server,agent,bus,invoke,sse,webhook,auth,convert}.go
- CLI: cmd/mandatum/main.go, internal/cli/core.go (the composition root), internal/cli/{serve,work,agent,tag,listen,version,update,format,client,render}.go
- Example: examples/local/main.go (zero infrastructure, no API key, no network)

## API Cheatsheet

- Topics: `topic.Parse(s)`, `topic.All()`, `topic.Agent(name)`, `topic.Run(agent, runID)`, `t.Covers(other)`, `t.Name()`, `t.RunID()`
- Addresses: `address.Parse("github://urmzd/mandatum/issues/42")`, `a.Connector`, `a.Workspace`, `a.Path`, `a.Param(k)`, `a.WithParam(k, v)`, `a.Resource()`
- Envelope: `envelope.Tag{ID, Tenant, Agent, Origin, Source, Text, Actor, Deliver, Meta, At}`, `tag.Validate()`, `tag.Routes()`; `envelope.Event{Seq, Topic, RunID, Tenant, Agent, Rev, Origin, Kind, Payload, At}`; `envelope.Route{Target, Kinds}.Wants(kind)`; `envelope.Filter{Kinds, Rev, Origin, RunID}.Allows(e)`; `envelope.Subscription{Topic, Filter, From}.Accepts(e)`
- Kinds: `delta.text`, `delta.thinking`, `delta.tool.call`, `delta.tool.done`, `delta.citation`, `lifecycle.{accepted,started,parked,resumed,completed,failed}`, `action.taken`, `control.{created,revised,deleted}`. `Kind.Family()` and `Kind.Matches(sel)` select a family or an exact kind.
- Connectors: `connector.Trigger{Ingest(ctx, out chan<- envelope.Tag)}`, `connector.Sink{Deliver(ctx, target, event)}`, `connector.Actor{Actions() []Action}`, `connector.RolesOf(c)`, `registry.Sink(target)`; sentinels `ErrUnsupported`, `ErrNotFound`, `ErrUndeliverable`
- Bus: `bus.Bus{Publish(ctx, e), Subscribe(ctx, sub) (Stream, error)}`, `Stream.Recv(ctx)`, `bustest.Run(t, factory)` holds any backend to the same contract
- Signature: `signature.NewSlack(secret)`, `signature.NewGitHub(secret)`, `Verify(header, body)`; sentinels `ErrSignatureMismatch`, `ErrTimestampSkew`, `ErrMalformed`, `ErrNoSecret`; `DefaultWindow` is 5 minutes and the boundary is inclusive
- Payloads: `payload.Of(event)` returns the typed body; `payload.Decode[T](event)`; types `Text`, `Thinking`, `ToolCall`, `ToolDone`, `Citation{Label, Text, Source, Index}`, `Lifecycle{Attempt, Rev, Terminal}`, `Action`
- CLI: `mandatum tag <agent> <text> [--deliver 'addr=kind,kind'] [--kinds] [--detach]`, `mandatum listen <topic> [--kinds] [--rev] [--origin] [--from]`, `mandatum agent {create,revise,get,list,history,delete}`, global `--format text|json`
